confidence_notes: June city averages support meals, coffee and draft beer. Cocktail and wine estimates reflect local prices relative to draft beer, with wine based on a small menu sample. July lodging prices are wet-season model estimates. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Siem-Reap), [Pub Street guide](https://www.angkortourism.org/pub-street-guide/), [Sambo menu](https://sambosiemreap.com/food-drink/), [Maom menu](https://maomkhmercuisine.com/drink-menu/).
comparable_city_reasoning: Budget lodging in mainland Southeast Asian heritage destinations provides a regional benchmark, with Siem Reap's large supply of hostels and guesthouses informing the estimates.
